item.title: Donkey Kong Bananza might not be the best game of the year, but it's surely the one I loved the most
item.description: I think these days, after years of Nintendo outright eschewing the console power rat race and focusing instead on different ways to play and honing their core craft, we forget that Nintendo is still a pretty sharp company in terms of technical innovation. item.title: Penises set Dispatch apart, and I mean that quite sincerely
item.description: I think a lot of Dispatch can be distilled into a single moment at the beginning of the game when the player comes face to face with a penis. There it is, dangling visibly between the legs of an unclothed, toxic-drenched super-villain you're about to fight. The camera all but centers on it. item.description: If we're plotting out the year based on unexpected obsessions, mine were (in no particular order) weird Italian genre cinema of the 60s and 70s, an unhealthy appetite for unnecessarily elaborate physical media collector's editions, folk horror in literally any form I could consume, and, apparently, No Man's Sky. item.title: Eurogamer readers' top 50 games of 2025 - "It made me cry three times"
item.description: 2025 has gone by in a flash, hasn't it?
